messages:
sophie (partnerships): heads-up 1 CloudForge + NitroHW reached out to co-host a 30m webinar focused on marketplace onboarding + live hardware demo. promo needs to start next week. can we lock speakers, demo flow, and swag by Wed?

ryan (eng): I can help. quick infra Qs: real NitroHW device or partner-hosted stream? and which precision to show (fp16/int8)?

elee (solutions): partners want live NitroHW box demo + a 1-click deploy from CloudForge marketplace. propose 7m device demo, 8m marketplace deploy, 10m Q&A. i'll draft the runbook.

sam (marketing): assets needed by Tue noon: headshots, 40-60w bios, 2-line blurb. recording rights? partners want on-demand gated behind a lead form. fine with legal?

kate (ops): swag budget $1.2k. recommend stickers + branded notebooks to simplify shipping. lead time ~9 business days after PO.

sophie (partnerships): action items: eilee -> runbook + demo commands (due Mon), ryan -> infra sizing & demo keys (due Mon), sam -> landing copy + collect bios (due Tue), kate -> finalize swag SKU & PO (due Mon). calendar-bot please propose rehearsal slots Wed & Thu mornings.

calendar-bot: tentative rehearsal invites sent for Wed 09:30-10:15 PT and Thu 09:00-09:45 PT. please RSVP by EOD Mon.

sam (marketing): partners please send a 1-slide architecture SVG and logo lockups.

elee (solutions): will request diagrams and push runbook link here.

sophie (partnerships): will convert to tracking doc after this thread. thanks :thumbsup:
